CONTINUING GUARANTY

The undersigned, Andersen Dairy Inc. (“Guarantor”), hereby guarantees to Medosweet Farms, Inc. (“Buyer”) that no article of food shipped or otherwise delivered to Buyer, as of the date of such shipment or delivery, will be adulterated or misbranded within the meaning of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, 21 U.S.C. §§ 331, 342 and 343, nor an article which may not, under the provisions of Section 404 or 505 of said Act, be introduced into interstate commerce.

Guarantor further certifies that all such articles are produced in facilities registered under the Public Health Security and Bioterrorism Preparedness and Response Act, and are manufactured in compliance with 21 CFR Part 117 (Current Good Manufacturing Practice, Hazard Analysis, and Risk-Based Preventive Controls for Human Food) and, where applicable, 21 CFR Part 1240 Subpart D.

Guarantor certifies that no ingredient supplied hereunder contains pesticide chemical residue in excess of the tolerance established under 40 CFR Part 180, and that any incidental additive is used at a level not exceeding 0.5 ppm of the finished article.

This guaranty is continuing and shall be effective for all articles shipped to Buyer until revoked in writing. It supersedes the guaranty dated January 4, 2024.
